sub_unit_name: Elastomers: Characteristics - Preparation - Properties and Applications of Buna-S, Butyl and Thiokol Rubber

content.title: What are Elastomers?
content.description: Elastomers are high molecular weight polymers that exhibit high elasticity. They can undergo large deformation under stress and return to their original shape when the stress is removed.

content.content: Elastomers are widely used in engineering because of their flexibility, resilience, abrasion resistance, and ability to withstand repeated stretching. They are used in tyres, seals, gaskets, hoses, conveyor belts, vibration dampers, and protective coatings.

content.title: Engineering Importance
content.content: Synthetic elastomers are designed to possess better resistance to heat, oils, chemicals, weathering, and aging than natural rubber.

items.question: High Elasticity
items.answer: Can stretch considerably and regain their original shape.

items.question: Flexible
items.answer: Remain flexible even under repeated deformation.

items.question: Chemical Resistance
items.answer: Many synthetic elastomers resist oils, solvents, and chemicals.

content.content: Buna-S (Styrene Butadiene Rubber) is prepared by the copolymerization of 1,3-butadiene and styrene. It is one of the most widely used synthetic rubbers due to its excellent abrasion resistance and durability.

rows: Automobile tyres, footwear, conveyor belts, hoses

content.content: Butyl Rubber is prepared by the copolymerization of isobutylene with a small amount of isoprene. It possesses excellent air-tightness, weather resistance, and chemical stability.

rows: Excellent air retention, weather and chemical resistance
Inner tubes, tyre liners, pharmaceutical stoppers, seals

content.content: Thiokol Rubber is prepared by the condensation polymerization of organic dihalides with sodium polysulfide. It exhibits outstanding resistance to oils, fuels, solvents, and chemicals.

rows: Condensation of organic dihalides with sodium polysulfide
Excellent oil, solvent and chemical resistance
Fuel hoses, aircraft components, gaskets, chemical seals

right_points: Used for seals, tubes and fuel systems

content.content: Buna-S is mainly used in automobile tyres, belts, footwear, and conveyor belts. Butyl rubber is used in tyre inner tubes, air-tight containers, seals, and pharmaceutical closures. Thiokol rubber is extensively used in aircraft fuel tanks, chemical plants, oil-resistant hoses, and sealing compounds.

content.title: Exam Tip
content.content: Questions are commonly asked on the preparation monomers, important properties, and applications of Buna-S, Butyl, and Thiokol rubber.

content.title: Quick Revision
points: Buna-S is prepared from butadiene and styrene.
Butyl rubber is prepared from isobutylene and isoprene.
Thiokol rubber is prepared using sodium polysulfide and organic dihalides.
Buna-S is mainly used in tyres.
Thiokol rubber has outstanding oil and chemical resistance.
